prior_method: REPRISE v4/CLAVIS-M3, no parameter tuning on new evaluation

development_unused.evidence: user explicitly confirmed neither consulted during method design

features.dtype: FP32 features and exact cosine, FP64 prototype statistics and LP state

LP.converged: cold state; ||next-u||2 / (0.1 ||next||2) <= 1e-6; maximum500, fail if not reached

method.TINS: upstream commit194759d716b27534bf2e8eeb0d71f5c4f0dabc40 plus read-only hooks; original fixed hyperparameters

experiment4.classes: 4 each from NINCO and SSB-hard, random among classes with >=40 unique eligible images
experiment4.queries: one at a time, clone pre-query state and discard; never share query images across probes
experiment4.peer_control: for history B16/B256, append 15/255 unscored reserve peers with each independent query, replace five static-difficulty matched unrelated peers by same-class peers; singleton primary, same vs unrelated secondary
experiment4.matching: greedy nearest abs log(product static B14/L14 p); paired residuals saved
experiment4.replacement: nested20 same-class/donor pairs, keep their positions and all ID images fixed across r
experiment4.CIs: class bootstrap of already-scored histories, 2000 resamples; preliminary only4classes/dataset

experiment5.fraction_manipulation: same unique OOD image sequence per recurrence/pattern, insert unique ID; no repeated image within a stream
experiment5.long_gap_r1: recorded but recurrence undefined, cannot support return-after-gap claim
experiment5.retention: last W stream arrivals: A1,A2,M eligibility ages and graph stream nodes; fixed support/calibration always retained; exact affected kNN recomputation on eviction
experiment5.operating_threshold: per-method 1% lower ID quantile pooled across old dev1 near streams seeds123/124/125; freeze before experiments; alarm score<threshold; same across all frequencies/recurrences/patterns/caps
operating: first-to-detection delay in images and same-class occurrences
experiment5.timing: 24 explicitly selected end-to-end jobs, panel0,r20: all fractions random x4caps, .1%long_gap x4caps, zeroOOD x4caps; includes raw image decoding/transforms/3encoders/TINS/memory/exactneighbors/graph/LP; other592jobs cached feature runtime labelled separately
experiment5.latency: sequential batch-ready service latency, no synthetic arrival queue; mean ms/image, last-quarter ms/image, batch and per-image completion p95
experiment5.memory: peak CPU RSS and PyTorch CUDA allocated/reserved, model and state included; startup separated; precomputed fixed shots not re-encoded in stream timing

feature_conditions: B14+L14 with frozen CLIP-text candidate policy, reference
experiment6.additional: actual online TINS and TINS times each comparator, explicitly labelled as VLM-conditioned
experiment6.baseline_selection: k=[1,2,3,5,10,20,50], shrinkage=[0,.001,.01,.05,.1,.2,.5], olddev1 only lowest nearFPR95 then AUROC; frozen before any new data results
experiment6.new_test_labels: only sampler and metrics; detector receives IDclass names when needed; singleimagefeature primary does not use text candidates
experiment6.split_integrity: decodedRGB exact duplicates excluded; no eval pixel duplicate of support/calibration; freeze manifest hash before encoding

metrics.FPR95: lowest observed ID score reaching >=95% ID acceptance; tiesaccepted; threshold=sortedID[floor(.05*nID)]; record achievedTPR and ID/OODties
metrics.difference_from_prior: fixed quantile convention can differ from prior closest-TPR ROC; all present comparisons same rule

execution.do_not_interrupt: existing R5 pipeline and all foreign processes
execution.GPU_start_guard: R5 tins runs done/DONE or no active R5processes, plus memory<1024MiB/util<10%; poll30s
execution.failed_conditions: record individually and block dependent experiments with reasons, never represent missing results as zero
